# Zuri Brand System v1

## 1. Approved creative direction

**Zuri is a steady, human supporting partner for Thai business operations.**

The identity combines the Amber Beacon logo with **Zuri Guide**, a warm and capable human character. The system should make operational work clear and less isolating without making false claims about agent authority, data freshness, or runtime activation.

| Element | Decision |
|---|---|
| Primary mark | Amber Beacon Z: two amber rays with a protected circular core |
| Corporate wordmark | `ZURI`, uppercase custom lockup beside or below the mark |
| Mascot | Zuri Guide, human female-presenting operations companion |
| Core line | **Your steady partner** |
| Supporting line | **Always in your corner.** |
| Product personality | Warm, calm, precise, non-judgmental, capable |
| Explicit non-goal | A generic AI command centre, a chatty assistant, or a claim that Zuri has taken an action it has not taken |

The emotional inspiration is a companion who stays present through mistakes and uncertainty. It is an internal creative principle only. Public material must not name, reproduce, or imply a connection to any film or third-party character.

## 3. Logo system

### 3.1 Primary lockup

Use the Amber Beacon mark to the left of `ZURI` for marketing, login, documents, and wide application headers. Use the stacked lockup only where width is constrained.

| Rule | Specification |
|---|---|
| Mark colour on light | `zuri-amber-500` |
| Wordmark on light | `sepia-950` |
| Mark colour on dark | `zuri-amber-400` or `warm-surface` only after contrast review |
| Minimum digital width | 112px for horizontal lockup, 32px for mark only |
| Clear space | at least one protected-core diameter on every side |
| Small-size fallback | mark only, never compressed wordmark |
| Prohibited | gradients, shadows, outlines, rotation, recolouring, stretching, or placing the mark inside a competing badge |

### 3.2 Circular LINE profile avatar

The official Zuri OA image is a bright circular portrait of **Zuri Guide** on a Warm Surface field with an amber outer ring. A simplified Amber Beacon mark sits behind and on her lapel. It contains no wordmark, slogan, live status, or tenant-specific colour. Keep a 10% outer safe margin around the portrait so LINE's crop stays clear. The mark-only Sepia avatar remains the fallback for security, system, or non-personal contexts.

### 3.3 Usage hierarchy

The primary mark represents the Zuri platform. The mascot represents helpful presence. They are not interchangeable: use the mark for identity, navigation, consent, permissions, runtime state, and official notices; use Zuri Guide for onboarding, empty states, encouragement, and clearly non-authoritative help.

## 4. Colour tokens

These values preserve the existing tokens in `src/styles/globals.css`. Semantic names make their purpose stable; no value is changed by this specification.

| Token | Value | Role | Allowed product use |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `zuri-amber-500` | `#E8820C` | Brand action | primary CTA, selected state, mark |
| `zuri-amber-400` | `#F09420` | Interactive amber | hover and limited highlight |
| `zuri-amber-700` | `#B86A08` | Amber depth | active state and accessible supporting text only |
| `zuri-amber-100` | `#FDE8D0` | Amber tint | selected-field and gentle support surface |
| `warm-surface` | `#FFF8F0` | Branded support canvas | onboarding, mascot or brand panels only |
| `surface-canvas` | `#F7F8FA` | Product canvas | default authenticated work surface |
| `surface-card` | `#FFFFFF` | Content surface | forms, tables, sections |
| `surface-mid` | `#EFF1F3` | Separation layer | toolbar, skeleton, inactive utility surface |
| `sepia-950` | `#1A1710` | Grounding ink/shell | navigation, primary text, LINE avatar field |
| `rest-blue-100` | `#D6ECFA` | System guidance | AI explanation, source/readiness context, never a success signal |
| `rest-blue-700` | `#3D7A9E` | Guidance text | text on rest-blue after contrast validation |
| `mustard-500` | `#C6A052` | Supporting accent | limited secondary highlight, never a primary action |
| `mustard-100` | `#F5ECD7` | Supporting tint | quiet supporting background |

### Colour rules

- Amber is an action and identity colour, not a decoration applied to every card.
- Rest Blue means explanation or safe system guidance, never "live", "approved", or "delivered".
- Success, warning, error, disabled, stale, denied, and runtime-admission states remain semantic states. They require an icon and text in addition to colour, and their final token ramp must meet WCAG 2.1 AA in implementation review.
- Tenant brand overrides are confined to tenant-branded surfaces. Zuri corporate identity, the LINE avatar, security notices, and source/runtime state retain canonical Zuri colours.

## 5. Typography and content voice

| Layer | Typeface direction | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| Product headings and labels | existing Prompt direction | page titles, section titles, compact labels |
| Thai-first reading and data | IBM Plex Sans Thai | body, forms, table data, helper text |
| Wordmark | custom drawn `ZURI` lockup | logo only, never body copy |

Use fixed product sizes: page title 24px, section title 18px, body/control 14px, supporting text 12px. Thai body copy uses 1.7–1.8 line height. Use sentence case for instructions and action labels. Avoid generic AI claims such as "done", "sent", "approved", or "live" unless server evidence verifies the state.

**Voice examples**

| Context | Preferred | Avoid |
|---|---|---|
| Help from Zuri | "ยังขาดการยืนยันกลุ่มก่อนส่งคำขอ" | "Zuri จัดการให้แล้ว" |
| Blocker | "ยังส่งรายงานไม่ได้: runtime delivery ยังไม่พร้อม" | "เปิดใช้งานสำเร็จ" |
| Support | "เริ่มจากตรวจรายการนี้ก่อน" | "คุณทำผิด" |
| Celebration | "เรียบร้อยแล้ว, งานนี้พร้อมสำหรับขั้นถัดไป" | emoji-only success or exaggerated praise |

## 6. Zuri Guide mascot system

### Character brief

Zuri Guide is a human young-adult Thai woman and a capable colleague, not an authority figure, a child, a robot, or a fictional character from another work. She has a dark bob haircut, an amber hair ribbon, warm expressive eyes, an ivory outer layer, Sepia base clothing, and a small Amber Beacon pin with a non-authoritative status light.

| Trait | Visual translation | Behavioural meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Attentive | relaxed posture, open hand, direct but gentle gaze | listens before suggesting |
| Capable | tidy silhouette and task-oriented props | helps make the next step clear |
| Warm | restrained smile and amber detail | support without judgment |
| Grounded | Sepia/ivory outfit and minimal visual effects | no magical or unearned promises |

### Approved pose family

1. **Listening:** seated or standing with attentive posture. Use in clarification and source-unavailable states.
2. **Helping:** pointing to a visible next step, never fabricating completion. Use in onboarding and empty states.
3. **Thinking:** calm, reflective expression. Use for pending or review-required states.
4. **Small win:** contained celebration. Use only after an observed completed action.

### Mascot guardrails

- Never place Zuri Guide beside destructive, billing, privacy-consent, security, or approval buttons in a way that pressures the user.
- Never use her as proof that a LINE message, report, automation, or agent action occurred.
- The Zuri OA profile image is the defined exception: use the approved bright portrait with the Amber Beacon mark. Keep the mark-only avatar for security, system, or non-personal contexts.
- For failure, denied, or legal content, keep the character absent or neutral. Lead with plain text and the concrete remedy.

## 7. Product design-system rules

The current Zuri shell and primitives remain the implementation base. This CI system changes their visual governance, not their authorization or runtime behaviour.

| Primitive | Required system behaviour |
|---|---|
| Button | one clear primary amber action per decision area; visible focus; default, hover, active, disabled, pending states |
| Input/select | label always visible, Thai-first error copy, focus ring independent from error styling |
| Badge/status | text plus icon; never use a generic "Active" value where configuration and runtime admission differ |
| Card/panel | compact, one border or a restrained shadow, not both as decoration |
| Table | preserve source/as-of and status context; responsive overflow must remain keyboard reachable |
| Empty state | explain what is absent, why it matters, and the next safe action; Zuri Guide is optional support imagery |
| Toast | confirms only an observed server response; never implies delayed work completed |
| Modal | use only when inline or a dedicated screen cannot express the decision safely |

### Motion and accessibility

- Product transitions: 150–250ms. Motion explains progress or state change only.
- Provide a `prefers-reduced-motion` equivalent for every new animation.
- Maintain visible keyboard focus, 4.5:1 body-text contrast, 3:1 large-text contrast, and text/icon labels for non-textual state.
- The mascot is decorative unless it conveys unique information; use empty alt text when decorative and meaningful Thai alt text only when it is instructional.

## 8. Asset package required for implementation

| Deliverable | Format | Consumers |
|---|---|---|
| Amber Beacon master mark | reviewed SVG | app, site, docs, favicon pipeline |
| Horizontal and stacked lockups | reviewed SVG | site, documents, wide headers |
| Dark/light/raster exports | PNG at 512, 256, 128, 96px | LINE OA, app stores, social profiles |
| LINE avatar | PNG 1024px square with safe zone | Zuri OA profile image; retain mark-only fallback |
| Zuri Guide poses | SVG or transparent WebP/PNG, named by pose | onboarding, empty states, support surfaces |
| Favicon/app icons | generated only from reviewed mark master | web manifest, app packaging |
| Token source | CSS custom properties plus a machine-readable token file | frontend implementation and documentation |

## 9. Adoption phases and acceptance gates

| Phase | Scope | Gate |
|---|---|---|
| 1. CI assets | draw master SVGs, export avatars, approve pose pack | visual review at 16px, 32px, 96px, light/dark backgrounds |
| 2. Token consolidation | document CSS/source token mapping, add semantic-state contract | contrast check and no tenant override leakage |
| 3. Shared primitives | align Button, Input, Badge, Status, EmptyState, Toast | keyboard and state-matrix review |
| 4. Shell rollout | logo, navigation, login, dashboard shell | representative desktop and mobile visual review |
| 5. Visual Office | apply the existing contract-led spec | no change to authorization, API, or runtime admission semantics |

## 10. Implementation boundary

This document authorises no production CSS, React components, credentials, deployment, or logo-trademark filing by itself. The next approved change must declare its files, test/visual-review method, and migration order in the Zuri Phase 1–3 workflow. Existing legacy glass/gradient styles are not removed by this design decision; they require an explicit migration scope.
